{{Quote|This is Center One. Four others are under construction, and Center Six is in the design phase, shepherded by an ambitious young engineer from the University of Cato Neimoidia.|Mas Amedda, to Mon Mothma|<ref name="MOF" />}}
The '''University of Cato Neimoidia''' was a [[university]] on<ref name="MOF" /> the [[Colonies]] [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="MOF" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{MOFdate}}</ref> a young [[Unidentified ambitious engineer|engineer]] from the university was shepherding the design phase of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] reeducation facility [[Center Six]].<ref name="MOF" /> That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> when [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]] showed [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] the construction site of a similar facility called [[Center One]], he told her of Center Six and mentioned that its designer was from the University of Cato Neimoidia.<ref name="MOF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The University of Cato Neimoidia was mentioned in the [[2025]] novel ''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'', written by [[Alexander Freed]] as the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Reign of the Empire]]'' trilogy.<ref name="MOF" />
